question: Two long parallel conductors carry currents in opposite directions. A student says that the force between them becomes attractive because both conductors carry current. Is the statement correct? Justify.

options.A: No. Parallel conductors carrying currents in opposite directions repel each other.
options.B: Yes. Any two current-carrying conductors always attract each other.
options.C: No. The force between them is zero because the currents cancel.
options.D: Yes. Opposite currents produce attraction because both conductors carry current.
